Bengals vs Steelers Betting History

The Cincinnati Bengals and Pittsburgh Steelers have met 113 times since the 1970 season. The Steelers lead the series 72-41. Against the closing spread the Bengals are 46-65-2 (Steelers 65-46-2), and the over is 45-50 in meetings with a closing total. Last meeting: Nov 16, 2025, Steelers 34-12.
